headline: Westpac's Group net interest margin fell 1 basis point in FY25 to 1.94%, from 1.95% in FY24 (results book KPI table, "Business performance - excluding Notable Items", Group NIM row: 1.94% vs 1.95%, (1 bps)). The movement is corroborated by the investor pack composition table (NIM 1.95% FY24, 1.94% FY25). NIM comprised Core NIM of 1.81% (down 1bp) and a stable Treasury & Markets contribution of 13bps. The FY25-FY24 walk (results book p12) attributes the 1bp decline to: Loans -1bp, Deposits -2bp, Liquid assets +2bp, Wholesale funding -1bp, Capital & other +1bp, and Treasury & Markets 0bp. The bars sum to -1bp, matching the reported movement with no residual.

drivers.columns: Full Year Sept 2024 to Full Year Sept 2025
drivers.narrative: Loan interest spread 1bp narrower. Higher spreads in New Zealand mortgages driven by fixed rate repricing were more than offset by tighter spreads in Australia due to competition and the sale of the auto finance portfolio.

drivers.columns: Full Year Sept 2024 to Full Year Sept 2025
drivers.narrative: Deposit interest spread decreased 2bps with a mix shift towards lower spread savings products, margin compression in term deposits and the impact from lower interest rates. Earnings on hedged deposits were higher.

drivers.columns: Full Year Sept 2024 to Full Year Sept 2025
drivers.narrative: Liquid Assets increased 2 basis points as average liquid assets rose by less than average lending assets.

drivers.columns: Full Year Sept 2024 to Full Year Sept 2025
drivers.narrative: Wholesale funding decreased 1 basis point from the impact of higher funding costs, with the final Term Funding Facility (TFF) draw downs maturing in the prior year.

drivers.columns: Full Year Sept 2024 to Full Year Sept 2025
drivers.narrative: Capital and Other increased 1 basis point primarily from higher earnings on hedged capital balances.

drivers.columns: Full Year Sept 2024 to Full Year Sept 2025
drivers.narrative: Treasury & Markets contribution was stable at 13 basis points, contributing 0bps to the FY25-FY24 movement.

limitations: The investor pack page 24 NIM walk (1H25→2H25) is a CONTEXT comparison, not the task's FY24→FY25 comparison, so its bars (Loans 0, Deposits 0, Liquid assets +3, Capital & Other -1, Wholesale funding 0, T&M +1) were not used as driver contributions. Its sub-driver annotations (e.g. consumer savings reprice +3bps, RBA rate changes -2bps) belong to the half-on-half period and are excluded.

The investor pack page 24 walk is the only other published walk; it covers a different period, so the FY25-FY24 walk is corroborated only by the composition table on investor pack page 46 (NIM 1.95%→1.94%), not by a second full walk of the same comparison.
The bank reports NIM excluding Notable Items; no statutory NIM is disclosed, so no statutory-vs-cash comparison is possible.
Basis normalised from 'cash' to 'ex_notables': no page in evidence prints 'cash' beside the movement, and the registry names ex_notables as the bank's headline basis.
